name: Wealth, Power, and Influence: Issues and Solutions

mentions.name: Wealth, Power, and Influence: Issues and Solutions
mentions.description: A personal research project investigating wealth, power, and influence, grounded in ontology, relationships, and epistemology. It maps the ontological placement of entities as a foundational mapping of wealth, power, and influence, and is published as a 688-page PDF, with a dated online version (Nov 2025, 493 pages) available on the project site.
